service.mountService: cos-backup.service active (ExecStart /usr/local/bin/mount-cos-backup.sh, primary internal endpoint, public HTTPS fallback)
service.watchdogAction: mountpoint/ls health check; umount -l and systemctl restart cos-backup on failure

existingUsage.notes: shared bucket; immich backup prefix mounted at /cos-backup/immich
existingUsage.librarySize: not measured (avoid full recursive listing of shared photo library)

compatibilityNotes: cosfs supports os.replace on files (atomicWriteFile path) and directory rename; directory rename is implemented as copy+delete at the client, so publishing a ~71-object backup point costs roughly one extra read+write+delete per object and ~10s wall time.
Directory rename is not atomic at the COS layer; a crash mid-publish can leave a partial final point. backup verify/recovery must remain the integrity gate (no claim of atomic publish).
Internal endpoint resolves to 169.254.0.47 and returns HTTP 400 in ~1.8ms for a bare GET; same-region CVM<->COS traffic is free per COS docs.
